6 bed student house to rent Highbury, Newcastle, NE2

Situated on one of the most prestigious streets of Jesmond this 6 bed house has unrivalled views to the west across the town moor. Ideally loca...

Read more

Situated on one of the most prestigious streets of Jesmond this 6 bed house has unrivalled views to the west across the town moor.
Ideally located within walking distance from the city centre and both universities and just along the road from West Jesmond Metro Station. There are gardens to both the front and side and as these face south and west, the house has sunlight all day.
The focal point of this house is the kitchen which is fully fitted with beech units complemented by dark worktops and a large stainless steel cooking range. The kitchen has been extended and incorporates a spacious dining area. Electrical appliances include washing machine, dishwasher, microwave and 2 integrated fridge/freezers. Access can be gained from the kitchen to the block-paved rear yard which is an ideal BBQ area.
The spacious lounge is furnished in a modern theme and the bay window in the lounge has uninterrupted views across the town moor.
All six bedrooms, two in the attic, three on the first floor and one on the ground floor, are of a good size. All the rooms, including kitchen and lounge, have been pre-wired for telephone, aerial and high speed internet connection.
There are a total of three bathrooms, one on each floor, and all are finished in a very modern/contemporary theme.
